govdocs-archive_org-nsia-KPLR_KPLR: KPLR-TV wrote to Harold Weisberg on March 16, 1972 to schedule his appearance on the Bill Fields Show. Television stations booked the assassination researcher as a talk guest in the years when his books were news. The surviving record gives the station, the date, and the show, but not the letter's details, so it stands as a dated booking letter from his broadcast rounds.
